integrity: Proof specifies exact threshold semantics and finite-dimensional rational-identity verification; no historical priority or independent certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only initially primitive-three states are counted; no eventual-basin or other-period census. The Bitar–Goles (1992) full text could not be accessed, and unindexed equivalent formulations remain possible. Finite verification is not an infinite proof or independent audit.
title: Exact primitive-three chip-mass bands and a rational census for fan graphs
